title: Remove the deathtouch blocker, attack in the air, pump for exact lethal
briefing: P1 has Serra Angel and Shivan Dragon (9 flying power) against P2 at 9 life, whose only flying blocker is Baleful Strix (1/1 flying, deathtouch). Swords to Plowshares removes the Strix but gives P2 1 life, so the attack is then 1 short: the Dragon's firebreathing ({R}: +1/+0) must be used with the two open Mountains. The full line is three different kinds of decision in the right order: removal before combat, both flyers at P2, pump during combat. Skipping the removal loses the Dragon to deathtouch.

reference.analysis: Angel 4 + Dragon 5 = 9 flying damage and P2 is at 9, but Baleful Strix blocks one flyer and kills it with deathtouch. Swords to Plowshares on the Strix before combat clears the way; its controller gains 1 life (the Strix's power), so P2 is at 10. Two untapped Mountains then give the Dragon +2/+0: 4 + 7 = 11, lethal. The pump can be done any time after attackers are declared; doing it precombat also works. Attacking first and hoping loses the Dragon to a deathtouch block. Using Swords on a bigger creature (P3's 10/10) removes more power from the table but kills nobody and leaves the Strix in the way.

lines.label: Swords the Strix, attack P2 with both flyers, pump the Dragon twice
lines.why: Eliminates P2 this turn and loses nothing.

lines.label: Swords the Strix, attack P2, forget the pump
lines.why: P2 gained 1 from Swords and survives at 1 life with two Mountains unused: a kill on the board thrown away.

lines.label: Attack P2 with both flyers without removing the Strix
lines.why: The Strix blocks the Dragon and kills it with deathtouch; P2 takes 4.

lines.label: Swords P3's Gigantosaurus, then attack P2 into the Strix
lines.why: Removes the largest creature, which was no threat this turn, and still loses the Dragon.

objectives.label: Shivan Dragon and Serra Angel both survive
Baleful Strix is removed before it can block
